# Nik Singhal Quoted in Mergers & Acquisitions Annual Due Diligence Study: The Biggest Risks & Obstacles Facing M&A Due Diligence


[Nik Singhal](https://www.orix.com/people/nik-singhal-orix-usa/) , ORIX USA’s Group Head of Direct Lending, recently shared his views for *Mergers and Acquisitions’* 2nd Annual Due Diligence Study. Nik discussed the growing importance of identifying underlying competitive threats during the due diligence process, as even established businesses with stable revenue streams face disruption risks.


Highlights from Nik:


- “Discovering hidden competitive threats as it has become easier to disrupt even those business models that appear to be good and stable with sticky revenues.”


[Read the Full Report](https://www.themiddlemarket.com/feature/the-biggest-risks-and-obstacles-facing-ma-due-diligence)


The full report requires a subscription to Mergers & Acquisitions.
